single.text:
MICROWAVE DIRECTIONS
Cooking times based on a 1100 watt microwave oven. Ovens vary; adjust time as needed.
1. Cut film to vent.
2. Cook on HIGH 3 1/2 minutes.
3. Stir sauce and re-cover.
4. Cook on HIGH 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes.
5. Let stand 1 minute. Product will be hot!
CONVENTIONAL OVEN 375°F
Remove film. Bake 40-45 minutes.

expected.oven_text: CONVENTIONAL OVEN 375°F. Remove film. Bake 40-45 minutes.

table_lines.text:
Microwave: Place bag flat in microwave, this side up. Cook on HIGH:
1200 watts 5 1/2 min.
1000 watts 6 min.
800 watts 7 min.
Below 800 watts, use stovetop directions.
Let stand 1 to 2 minutes. Carefully hold corners and tear open.

table_inline.text: Microwave on HIGH: 1200W 5-5 1/2 MIN | 1000W 7-7 1/2 MIN | 700W 8 1/2-9 MIN. Let stand 1 minute in microwave.

alt_line.text: Microwave (1000 watts): Stand bag upright. Cook on HIGH 5 1/2 to 6 minutes. 700 W: 7 min. Let stand 1 minute.

clock.text: Fill to line with water. Microwave on HIGH for 2:15. Stir and let sit 1 minute.

seconds.text: Squeeze pouch to separate rice. Tear 2 inch vent. Heat on HIGH 90 seconds.

do_not.text: DO NOT MICROWAVE. Oven bake only, raw chicken. Preheat oven to 375°F. Bake 30-35 minutes to 165°F.

expected.oven_text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Bake 30-35 minutes to 165°F.

do_not_alt_row.text: Not for microwave ovens above 1200 watts. Cook 5 minutes. 700 W: 7 min.

internal_temp.text: Cook on HIGH 4 minutes. Stir. Cook on HIGH 2 to 3 minutes or until hot (165°F). Let stand 2 minutes.

real_tj_birria.text:
HEATING INSTRUCTIONS: HEAT FROM FROZEN
MICROWAVE (1200 watt): Microwave heat times may vary depending on oven wattage. Heat from frozen. Remove outer packaging and carefully puncture film. Heat on high for 2 1/2 minutes. Carefully remove film and stir. Heat for an additional 2 1/2 minutes or until product reaches 165°F.
STOVETOP: Thaw product in the refrigerator overnight. Pour contents of tray into a pot. Bring to a boil over medium heat.

real_tj_bulgogi.text: MICROWAVE (1200 watt) Microwave cook times may vary depending on oven wattage. Do not remove the seal film before cooking. Cook on high for 4 to 5 minutes or until an internal temperature of 165°F is reached with a food thermometer. The film may balloon slightly. Let stand for 1 to 2 minutes. Carefully remove the film, stir gently and enjoy.

real_tj_just_chicken.text: HEATING INSTRUCTIONS: MICROWAVE (1200 WATT): Microwave heat times may vary depending on oven wattage. Puncture film and microwave on high for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until heated through.

real_tj_rosemary.text:
HEATING INSTRUCTIONS: CONVENTIONAL OVEN (Preferred method): Preheat oven to 350°F. Lift one corner of film. Place tray on a baking sheet on center rack of oven. Heat 20 to 25 minutes or to an internal temperature of 160°F.
MICROWAVE (1200 watt): Microwave cook times may vary depending on oven wattage. Place tray in microwave and heat 2 to 3 minutes on HIGH; let sit 1 minute before removing film.

real_tj_nuggets_seconds.text:
HEATING INSTRUCTIONS: CONVENTIONAL OVEN Preheat oven to 425°F. Heat for 10 to 12 minutes, flipping halfway through.
MICROWAVE (1200 watt): Place a single layer of nuggets on a microwave-safe plate. Microwave on high for 50 seconds. Let stand for 2 to 3 minutes before serving.
AIR FRYER: Heat for 6 to 8 minutes.

real_gg_mashed.text:
Heat & Serve
1. Puncture film and microwave on HIGH for 3 minutes.
2. Carefully remove film and stir.
3. Microwave uncovered 1 minute longer or until hot.
4. Let stand 1 minute before serving.
Microwave ovens may vary; adjust heating times accordingly.

real_gg_cavatappi.text:
Microwave
1. Remove film. Cover with paper towel.
2. Microwave on HIGH for 2 minutes; stir and replace paper towel.
3. Microwave 1½ to 2½ minutes longer or until hot.
Caution: Package and contents will be hot.

real_factor_intervals.text: MICROWAVE COOKING INSTRUCTION: 1. Remove outer sleeve and pierce film with a fork. 2. Microwave on HIGH for 2 minutes. If needed, continue cooking in 30 second intervals until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. 3. Let stand for 2 minutes. Carefully remove film.

real_readymeals_teriyaki.text: HEATING INSTRUCTIONS: MICROWAVE: Remove lid. Cover tray and place in the center of microwave. Heat on High for 3–3.5 minutes or to 165°F. Let rest for 1 minute before serving. Note: The power of microwave ovens varies. You may have to adjust cooking time.

real_readymeals_ziti.text: MICROWAVE: Remove lid. Cover tray and place in the center of microwave. Heat on High for 3.5–4 minutes or to 165°F. Let rest for 1 minute before serving.

real_deli_pork_bun.text: READY TO HEAT: MICROWAVE TIMES MAY VARY. REMOVE LID AND MICROWAVE ON HIGH 30 SEC-1 MINUTES OR UNTIL THE MEAL REACHES AN INTERNAL TEMP OF 165F.

real_pfchangs_egg_rolls.text:
MICROWAVE OVEN
1 Place 4 egg rolls on a small microwave-safe plate; cover with damp paper towel.
2 Microwave on HIGH 1 to 1 ½ minutes. HANDLE CAREFULLY; THEY'RE HOT! Remove paper towel and let stand 1 minute; serve and enjoy!
SIGNATURE SAUCE PACKET: DO NOT MICROWAVE. Place sauce packet in warm water to thaw.
Microwave directions developed with 1100-watt microwave ovens. Appliances vary.
